name: WeightSorter
description: Weight sorting: a box heavier than 3.5 kg is pushed to the heavy bin, a lighter one is let go, twelve boxes.

local.name: Step
local.comment: One step per move: 0 wait for a stable box, 1 push it out, 2 pull the pusher back, 3 release it to the light bin

local.name: Releasing
local.comment: The blade stays down long enough for a light box to leave the scale

inputs.name: Stable
inputs.comment: Scale1.stable: a box has rested on the scale long enough to be weighed

inputs.name: Extended
inputs.comment: Pusher1.extended: the pusher is at the end of its stroke

inputs.name: Retracted
inputs.comment: Pusher1.retracted: the pusher is back at rest

inputs.name: Weight
inputs.comment: Scale1.weight: the weight in kg, 0 while a box moves

outputs.name: RunOutfeed
outputs.comment: Outfeed.run: run the belt to the light bin

outputs.name: RunSide
outputs.comment: SideBelt.run: run the belt to the heavy bin

outputs.name: Hold
outputs.comment: Blade1.extend: the blade holds the box on the scale while true

outputs.name: Push
outputs.comment: Pusher1.extend: push the box off the infeed onto the side belt

outputs.name: Green
outputs.comment: StackLight1.green: all twelve boxes are sorted
